close_reason: Fixed: flowProps adds onMove; a step or end of the person's move (with an event) that changed the viewport from its start stops following, and an unchanged end leaves the start in place. title: composites: Toaster and useToasts
description: Per pb-nx9.37. A pure queue with unit tests on fake timers; text as ReactNode; placement as a prop so a canvas can host the stack inside its own panel. Default words as props, as Dialog and ThemeSwitch take them, unless pb-nx9.23 decides otherwise.
design: Built per D11. Queue pure in src/hooks/use-toasts/toastQueue.ts (addToast, dismissToast, clearToasts, holdToasts, expireToasts, nextToastExpiry, visibleToasts; toastDefaults duration 8000, coalesceWindow 5000, visible 4). useToasts({duration, coalesceWindow, visible, now}) returns {toasts, show, dismiss, clear, toasterProps}. Toaster (composites): placement top-start|top|top-end|bottom-start|bottom|bottom-end|inline (unknown drawn inline), absolute in the nearest positioned container; newest nearest the edge; text is ReactNode; its news is read through two hidden live regions the Toaster keeps mounted (alert for err, status otherwise; see pb-gbo), the visible toasts are not live regions; an action runs then dismisses the toast; Dismiss described by the text; per-toast duration (Infinity = until dismissed); hold released by the time each toast was held (since max(hold start, last shown)); after a dismissal holding focus, focus moves to the neighbour toast, else back where it came from. Words as props with English defaults (label, dismissLabel, moreLabel, countLabel) per D14.

title: composites: CommandPalette and ShortcutSheet
description: CommandPalette: commands {id, label, group?, hint?, keys?, run, disabled?}; subsequence ranking with matched letters in <mark>; arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Enter; centred, or anchored at a point and kept 320x360 inside the window; Tab per pb-nx9.36; empty and no-match states; focus returned on close. ShortcutSheet gains the open prop the sketch lacks (controlled, rule 5), shows keys through keyLabel, takes a note as children.
design: Built (2026-11-26) per D9. CommandPalette: commands {id, label, group, keys?, hint?, run, disabled?} (group required, as the design sketch; hint is a string, shown not matched). Ranking: subsequence in any case, white space in the query ignored; best alignment by DP (label start +3, word start +2, adjacent letters +2, gaps -0.1 each up to -1, late start -0.02 per char); groups ordered by their best match, items best first, ties in given order; empty query keeps the given order. Pure exports: rankCommands, matchSubsequence, markRuns, placePalette. Keys: focus stays in the combobox field (aria-activedescendant); arrows wrap, PageUp/PageDown move a listful, Home/End go to first/last (Shift+Home/End stay with the field), Enter runs; disabled commands are listed but skipped. Running asks onClose then calls run. Escape, Tab, a press outside and focus leaving close; focus goes back to the opener unless it moved elsewhere. Centred over the scrim (max 560 px wide), or anchored at={x,y}: 320x360 at most, clamped inside the window less an 8 px gutter, shrunk in a smaller window, follows resize. Empty and no-match words in a role=status present from the start. An option's accessible name is its visible words (label, hint, keys): axe's label-content-name-mismatch refuses a name narrower than the text. ShortcutSheet: open, onClose, shortcuts {keys, label, group}[], children as a note, words title/orLabel/emptyLabel/closeLabel, platform, keyNames; built on Dialog; groupShortcuts exported.
close_reason: Built: CommandPalette and ShortcutSheet in /composites

title: graph: Meter and useLiveValue
description: subscribe(listener) -> unsubscribe, read() -> [peak, rms], orientation, reset. Paints through refs with no React state per frame; requestAnimationFrame only while the level moves; peak hold and fall, clip lamp; scale per pb-nx9.35. useLiveValue(subscribe, read). Fake-timer tests.
design: Built rules: useLiveValue(subscribe, read, onValue?) returns a ref to the last value; it subscribes in a layout effect, reads at once and on every notification, hands each value to onValue, never sets React state, keeps the latest read and onValue without resubscribing, resubscribes on a new subscribe, ignores calls after unmount. The optional third argument (the paint) was added to the settled (subscribe, read) signature, since Meter must paint without re-rendering. Meter: scale per pb-nx9.35 (floor -60, zones -18/-6, hold 1.5 s, fall 20 dB/s, clip at 1.0 held 2 s); the tick rides the current peak once the fall meets it and is hidden below the floor; rAF only while a tick is above the current peak, the lamp is lit, or (hovered) the tooltip lags the level; tooltip on pointer entry, then at most every 250 ms while hovered. The element carries --pb-meter-level, --pb-meter-tick, --pb-meter-mid-at and --pb-meter-hot-at (its own, not tokens), data-peak and data-clipped. No React Flow import; docs/graph.md#meter.
notes: Props settled in docs/design/patchbay.md §4.4 (pb-nx9.38, closed 2026-11-26); build to that text and move it into docs/graph.md.
close_reason: Meter and useLiveValue built (docs/graph.md, docs/components.md#uselivevalue)

title: hooks: useShortcuts and useMediaBreakpoint
description: useShortcuts(map): one window listener, handler in a ref, Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere, the text field rule from pb-nx9.36, agreeing with React Flow's .nokey and input filtering so Delete and Backspace coexist; exports keyLabel(keys, platform) and isTextTarget; the map's key syntax is what ShortcutSheet and CommandPalette show. useMediaBreakpoint() returns { width: "wide" | "narrow" | "phone", touch } (760 and 600 px; (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)), on useSyncExternalStore, safe without a window.
design: Built (owner D9, 2026-11-25/26): a binding table { keys, run, inTextFields?, enabled?, repeat?, preventDefault? } read by one window keydown listener. Mod is Cmd on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere; modifiers are matched exactly, except a character Shift makes need not name Shift; letters and digits fall back to event.code when Alt or the layout changed the character (not when a different Latin letter was typed). In a text field (text-like input, textarea, select, editable content, or inside React Flow's .nokey) single keys and Escape never act; chords act only when their binding sets inTextFields. First matching binding runs; preventDefault by default; auto-repeat only with repeat: true; defaultPrevented and composing presses are skipped. keyLabel(keys, { platform, names }) and ariaKeyShortcuts. useMediaBreakpoint: { width: wide | narrow (<760) | phone (<600), touch: (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) } on useSyncExternalStore, answering wide/not touch with no window.
close_reason: Built: docs/components.md#useshortcuts and #usemediabreakpoint

title: design: settle the graph layer's props for build
description:
Turn design §4.4's sketches into build-ready props, checked against two neutral node shapes (a live-level node with a footer; a staged-edit node with typed ports and inputs and outputs on one row):
- NodeBox: geometry (open, the owner's call: fixed exported constants, or tokens a brand may change; leaning: width as a prop, header, row and padding exported as constants mirrored by documented tokens), stripe tone incl. accent, disabled (dashed border, hatched stripe) and failed looks, change, status/line/footer slots, how an app registers it as a nodeType.
- PortRow: id passed to <Handle> unchanged; hint ok | no | origin | null; problem; typeLabel; trailing; a 10 px dot with a 20 px target; updateNodeInternals when ports change.
- Wire: tone (open), emphasis applied through a CSS variable so a level change does not rebuild the path, dashed, flow on --pb-motion-flow (off under reduced motion), label at the midpoint, optional arrow marker, a title on the hit path, React Flow's edge-path and interaction classes kept.
- GhostWire: endpoints as handle ids, a tone for the refused flash, not selectable.
- Meter: per its decide bead; reset; a title formatter.
- useConnectHints: canConnect returns a boolean or a reason; how hints reach PortRow.
- Canvas sugar beside the app's own <ReactFlow> (pb-nx9.15: no wrapper): CanvasTools (the ToolGroup for a React Flow <Panel>: zoom, fit, tidy, minimap; minimap node class from the app), useAddAt (onAddAt(point, from?) on a double-click on empty canvas or a wire dropped there), useFollowFit (fit again on changes until the person moves the view, with an onFitted callback).
- The React Flow 12 range tokens.css's --xy-* map is checked against.
Closes pb-nx9.15 when done.
design: Settled 2026-11-26 in docs/design/patchbay.md §4.4 under the owner's decisions (2026-11-25/26: patchbay's model is the standard). React Flow >=12.1.0 <13 (onConnectEnd's connection state; peer narrows to ^12.1.0 when /graph ships); the --xy-* map's 18 names are declared in 12.0.0 through 12.12.1. Geometry (D12): constants NODE_WIDTH 240, NODE_HEADER 46, NODE_LINE 22, NODE_ROW 22, NODE_PAD 8, NODE_FOOTER 28, HANDLE_SIZE 10, HANDLE_HIT 20 (32 on touch), mirrored by --pb-node-* tokens a brand may not set, plus nodeBoxSize(); --pb-row stays the compact control height. NodeBox: title, subtitle, tone stripe (open, accent included), disabled, failed, change + changeLabels, status/line/footer slots, inputs/outputs as PortSpec[], ports stacked|side-by-side, selected, width; calls updateNodeInternals itself. PortRow: id to <Handle> unchanged, side, label, typeLabel, hint ok|no|origin|null, reason, problem, trailing, connectable. useConnectHints(canConnect -> true|false|reason) -> flowProps + value for <ConnectHints>; mergeFlowProps. Wire data: tone, emphasis via --pb-wire-emphasis, dashed, flow, arrow (drawn, no marker), label, title; BaseEdge classes kept. GhostWire: edge type ghost, tone pending|refused. Meter (D10): subscribe/read, orientation, floor -60, zones [-18,-6], holdMs 1500, fallDbPerS 20, clipAt 1.0, clipHoldMs 2000, label, title formatter, ref reset(). Canvas sugar (D1): CanvasTools (Panel + MiniMap, onFit, onTidy, minimap, minimapNodeClassName, keyShortcuts, labels), useAddAt(onAddAt(point, from?)), useFollowFit({key, fitOptions, onFitted}) -> {following, fit, flowProps}.
close_reason: Props settled in docs/design/patchbay.md §4.4 (docs(design): settle the graph layer's props).

title: decide: how much toast queue logic useToasts owns
description: The sketch is show({tone, text, action?}). Options: own the generic mechanics as options with defaults (expiry on the monotonic clock, coalescing by an app-given key within a window with a xcount, newest n shown plus "and m more", hold while hovered or focused with the expiry shifted, role by tone, an action plus Dismiss, Escape on a focused toast stopping propagation, placement as a prop); or stay thin. Leaning: own the mechanics.
design: Decided by the owner (D11, 2026-11-25/26): useToasts owns the whole queue model as options with defaults: coalesce by an app-given key within a window with an xN count; hold while hovered or focused, each expiry moved on by the time held; show the newest four and fold the rest into 'and n more'; role by tone (alert for err, status otherwise); an action plus Dismiss; Escape dismisses the focused toast and stops propagation; 8 s expiry on the monotonic clock. Placement is a Toaster prop. Wording, codes and subjects stay in the app. Not decided by the owner but chosen when building (pb-nx9.48), open to change: the window's length, 5000 ms (coalesceWindow), measured from the key's last showing.
close_reason: Decided (D11); built in pb-nx9.48

title: decide: chords in text fields, Tab in the palette, a per-command hint
description: Design §4.5 says shortcuts never fire inside a text field; apps expect Cmd+K-style chords to work while typing. A palette is a transient combobox popover: does Tab close it, or trap like Dialog? Do commands carry a hint or description line? Leaning: single keys and Escape never in text fields, chords by opt-in per binding; Tab closes; add hint.
design: Decided by the owner (D9, 2026-11-25/26): chords may act inside text fields only when a binding opts in; single keys and Escape never do; the palette closes on Tab (combobox convention); palette items have an optional hint line. The key half is built in useShortcuts (pb-nx9.41); the palette half goes with pb-nx9.45.
close_reason: Decided by the owner (D9); rules in the design field

title: decide: does Meter own a dB scale?
description: Options: Meter takes scale props (floor, zone thresholds behind --pb-meter-*, hold time, fall rate, clip threshold and hold) with documented defaults (-60 dBFS floor, zones at -18 and -6, 1.5 s hold, 20 dB/s fall, 2 s clip at 1.0 linear); or Meter draws 0..1 fractions and the app owns the scale. Leaning: scale props.
design: Decided 2026-11-26 by the owner (D10): Meter owns the dB scale as props with defaults: floor -60 dBFS, zones at -18 and -6 dBFS, peak hold 1.5 s, fall 20 dB/s, clip lamp held 2 s at 1.0 linear (0 dBFS). Settled as props floor, zones, holdMs, fallDbPerS, clipAt, clipHoldMs in docs/design/patchbay.md §4.4.

title: graph: every view move the person asks for stops useFollowFit's following (zoom tools and keys, minimap drag)
description: Rule U63 (docs/ux-rules.md#the-view-and-the-canvas): any move of the view the person asks for, by any input (pan, wheel, pinch, the zoom tools and their keys, a minimap drag, going to a node), stops following; layout and canvas-size changes never restart it; only Fit follows again. Today only a move with an event stops it: CanvasTools' zoom tools move by code, so a later key change or resize refits and undoes the person's zoom. Change: CanvasTools' zoom calls stop() (through an onZoom prop, or a following context useFollowFit provides), an app's own zoom keys likewise, and a minimap drag counts as the person's move; graph.md's useFollowFit and CanvasTools sections; drop the Not yet in U63.
